title: hahnia suecica var. mougeotii
intro: Hahnia suecica var. mougeotii, commonly known as Wild Licorice, is a perennial plant species native to Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions that aid in soothing digestive issues, reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting respiratory health. The health benefits of Wild Licorice are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include glycyrrhizin, flavonoids, and saponins that exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-ulcerogenic, anti-oxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. Regular consumption of Wild Licorice is believed to improve overall well-being by alleviating symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and promoting a balanced gut microbiome.
